profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Honeywell Aerospace
profile.summary:
I am a Computer hardware devotee, with hands-on experience with developing a full Test Automation Software on RF station, FPGAs design, embedded systems, and real-time operating systems. Be familiar with network analyzer, spectrum analyzer and other RF equipment. 

Technologies I have extensive experience in: TestStand, LabVIEW, C/C++, Python, Verilog.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developing Automated Software on Automated Test Equipment (ATE) to test Digital, RF, and Mixed-Signal.
- Developing Semi Automated Software Modules or Manual Software Modules to support RF designers and production for new trial products.
- Validating Acceptance Test Procedure and troubleshooting both software and hardware (ATE stand).
- Developing automatic calibration for ATE with RF Interface Unit (RFIU)/RF Switch Matrix.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developing Automated Software to test Digital, RF, and Mixed-Signal.
- Developing Semi Automated Software Modules or Manual Software Modules to support production.
- Developing simulation to support Engineer tasks on Network Analyzer (PNA-X) and Spectrum Analyzer (PXA).
positions.insights: Skills: Support Management · Technical Project Leadership · Software Troubleshooting · Leadership Development · Creative Problem Solving

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed Automated Software to test SEWIP Block II and SEWIP Block III's products
- Collaborated with RF Engineers to propose new Automated Software Test Set for a new BAE's product.

positions.title: ATE Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed ATE softwares for SEWIP BLOCK II and SEWIP BLOCK III Programs of Northrop Grumman.
- Updated and rebuilt all existing softwares from Window XP and Window 7 to Window 10 and made sure these major updates did not impact production.

positions.title: Electrical Engineer
positions.description:
- Developing and integrating a full automation test on RF station to control Network Analyzer, Spectrum Analyzer and Signal Generators to drive stimulus RF/IF signal to and measure data from an end product.
- Experienced in developing software for RF/IF up and down converter design. 
- Configure NI PXIe FPGA module and develop logic algorithm to control digital input/output samples.
- Configure the main switch matrix to perform a full test automation software and reduce testing time.
- Experience in characterization and calibration of RF switch matrix and equipment.
- Strong data analysis, experience in repeatability and correlation analysis.
- Be familiar with RF/IF gain measurement, attenuation test, gain compression, noise figure, Input third order intercept point, output power measurement, harmonic and spurious test.
- Experience in designing and building test fixture for end products.
- Programming skill: C and C++, Python, TestStand, LabVIEW, Lab Windows and Verilog.

positions.title: Co-Founder and Business Development Manager
positions.description:
Obtain & analyze customer requirements for existing and new products. Design, create and test products to meet customer needs.
Research & apply process engineering techniques to optimize the company’s product manufacturing process, in order minimize waste, save time while obtaining maximum product yields.

positions.title: Director of Operations
positions.description:
Actively working with both external customers and in-house teams: retrieve and analyze their needs to design, implement and test both of the following in multiple iterations (using Magento):
- A customer-facing website which users are not tech-savvy.
- An internal software infrastructure to manage orders and inventory.

positions.title: Lab assistant
positions.description: Organized and prepared materials for Science lab sessions. Installed computer and fix lab’s electrical equipment.

courses.name: CS2303 - System Programming and Data Structures

volunteerExperiences.description: Teach and prepare students for confirmation sacrament.
